SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.LOT_NO,B.IT_NAME) AS SrNoM,A.LOT_NO As LotNoL,C.RecIt As RecItL,B.IT_NAME As ItNameL,SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '-' THEN IR_PCS ELSE 0 END)As IsPcsM,SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN IR_PCS ELSE 0 END)As RcPcsM,SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '-' THEN IR_WT+(ITM_GWT-ITM_NWT) ELSE 0 END)As IsuWtW,SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN (IR_WT+RTN_CHOL+RTN_GHIS+ITM_GHAT+ITM_LOSS) ELSE 0 END) As RecWtW,SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '-' THEN IR_WT+(ITM_GWT-ITM_NWT) ELSE 0 END)-SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN (IR_WT+RTN_CHOL+RTN_GHIS+ITM_GHAT+ITM_LOSS) ELSE 0 END) As DifWtW,A.IT_CODE As IsuItL,A.IR_YRCD As MfgYearL,A.IR_DBCD As MfgDbCdL,A.IR_NO As MfgNoL,A.IR_SRNO As MfgSrNo FROM (MFG_ISU_REC AS A INNER JOIN(SELECT CO_CODE,LC_CODE,CO_YEAR,CO_BOOK,VCH_NO,SR_NO,ISU_IT_CODE As RecIt FROM MFG_DETL) AS C ON A.CO_CODE = C.CO_CODE AND A.LC_CODE = C.LC_CODE AND A.CO_YEAR = C.CO_YEAR AND A.CO_BOOK = C.CO_BOOK AND A.VCH_NO = C.VCH_NO AND A.SR_NO = C.SR_NO)LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON C.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE And C.RecIt = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.KR_AC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.AC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LOT_NO <> '' AND A.IR_TYPE IN (' ? ') GROUP BY A.LOT_NO,A.IT_CODE,B.IT_NAME,C.RecIt,A.IR_YRCD,A.IR_DBCD,A.IR_NO,A.IR_SRNO HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '-' THEN IR_WT ELSE 0 END)-SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '+' THEN (IR_WT+RTN_CHOL+RTN_GHIS+ITM_GHAT+ITM_LOSS) ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY A.LOT_NO DESC,B.IT_NAME

SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY A.LOT_NO,B.IT_NAME) AS SrNoM,A.LOT_NO As LotNoL,A.IT_CODE As ItCodeL,B.IT_NAME As ItNameL,SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '-' AND IR_TYPE = ' ? ' THEN IR_PCS ELSE 0 END)As IsPcsM,SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '-' AND IR_TYPE = ' ? ' THEN IR_PCS ELSE 0 END)As RcPcsM,SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '-' AND IR_TYPE = ' ? ' THEN IR_WT+DM_WT ELSE 0 END)As IsuWtW,SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '-' AND IR_TYPE = ' ? ' THEN IR_WT ELSE 0 END) As RecWtW,SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '-' AND IR_TYPE = ' ? ' THEN IR_WT+DM_WT ELSE 0 END)-SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '-' AND IR_TYPE = ' ? ' THEN IR_WT ELSE 0 END) As DifWtW,'' As IsuItL,'' As MfgYearL,'' As MfgDbCdL,'' As MfgNoL,'' As MfgSrNo FROM MFG_ISU_REC AS A LEFT JOIN ITEM_MAST AS B ON A.CO_CODE = B.CO_CODE And A.IT_CODE = B.IT_CODE WHERE A.CO_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.AC_CODE = ' ? ' AND A.LOT_NO <> '' AND A.IR_TYPE IN (' ? ',' ? ') GROUP BY A.LOT_NO,A.IT_CODE,B.IT_NAME HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '-' AND IR_TYPE = ' ? ' THEN IR_WT ELSE 0 END)-SUM(CASE WHEN ITM_SIGN = '-' AND IR_TYPE = ' ? ' THEN IR_WT ELSE 0 END) > 0 ORDER BY A.LOT_NO DESC,B.IT_NAME
